results.title: Jensen Huang Keynote at AI Infrastructure Summit: The Agentic Era
results.content: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang unveiled next-generation Rubin Ultra hardware architectures and stressed the rapid enterprise transition toward agentic reasoning systems.

results.title: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang Discusses Sovereign AI Investments on Bloomberg TV
results.content: Jensen Huang highlighted sovereign AI deployments across European and Asian governments, projecting $50B in national computing investments over 3 years.

results.title: Jensen Huang Receives Global Engineering Leadership Award in Tokyo
results.content: NVIDIA co-founder and Chief Executive Jensen Huang was honored in Tokyo with the IEEE International Leadership Award for contributions to parallel computing.

results.title: Jensen Huang Bio and NVIDIA Executive Profile
results.content: Jensen Huang co-founded NVIDIA in 1993 and has served since its inception as president, chief executive officer, and a member of the board of directors.
